watches.name: Quartet - Set of 4
watches.description: The Quartet – Set of 4 brings together all four Signature watches, with the flexibility to tailor the selection to your preference, such as two Gold dials and two Blue dials. For those looking to build the complete collection, the Quartet represents the most compelling way to do so compared to selecting each piece individually. As part of this set, you will receive a complimentary Watch Display Deck in collaboration with Holme & Hadfield. Crafted from wood and finished with genuine leather inlays, it offers a refined and practical way to present the collection. The Signature collection is our interpretation of the modern dress watch, inspired by classic designs from the 1930s to 1960s. Each piece features a vertically brushed metallic dial with deeply engraved Breguet numerals, custom heat blued spade hands, and a slim 37.5 mm stainless steel case. The Swiss hand wound Sellita SW210-1b movement is visible through a sapphire caseback, with a handmade leather strap made of genuine Ostrich leather. A total number of four Ostrich straps are included in each purchase. The four colours are black, blue, brown and cognac. Please Note: By placing your order, you acknowledge and agree that this is a made-to-order preorder with an estimated delivery of December 2026. As production has commenced, all orders are final and non-refundable.
